newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index drops 0.061pts to 102.380.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index drops 0.061pts to 102.380.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.061 points in Thursday's trading to 102.380, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.390 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell by 0.125 points to 98.999 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.004 points to 2.261 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 gained 0.567 points to 1,070.258.
